record.one_liner: FanBasis, now known as Commas, is an all-in-one platform for online sales, communities, courses, webinars, and payments featuring embedded checkouts, APIs, SDKs, and an MCP integration.
record.blocker: Insufficient documentation regarding authentication methods, access tiers, and complete API endpoints.

api_type.quote: Enterprise & APIs Embedded checkouts, multi-rail payouts, APIs and SDKs.

official_mcp.quote: MCP beta Run Commas from your AI assistant. Create checkout links, issue refunds and pull your numbers in plain English.
